stories.title: Anthropic's 的浮水印推出在兩個較舊的 Claude 模型上留下了漏洞 / Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models

sources.title: Anthropic's 的浮水印推出在兩個較舊的 Claude 模型上留下了漏洞 / Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
sources.title_zh: Anthropic's 的浮水印推出在兩個較舊的 Claude 模型上留下了漏洞
sources.title_en: Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
sources.title_original: Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
sources.summary: Anthropic is expanding its text watermark to four more Claude models to meet the EU AI Act's December deadline. On the older models Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, developers can bypass the watermark by tweaking a single sampling parameter. Anthropic addresses the loophole with just a compliance warning. The article Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在將其文字浮水印擴展到其他四個 Claude 模型，以符合歐盟人工智慧法案（EU AI Act）的 12 月期限。在舊款模型 Claude Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 上，開發人員可以透過調整單一取樣參數來繞過浮水印。Anthropic 則僅透過合規警告來處理此漏洞。

stories.title: OpenAI 計畫使用先前屬於禁區的 Daybreak Blue 網路安全研討會資料來訓練模型 / OpenAI plans to train models on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data that was previously off-limits

sources.title: OpenAI 計畫使用先前屬於禁區的 Daybreak Blue 網路安全研討會資料來訓練模型 / OpenAI plans to train models on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data that was previously off-limits
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 計畫使用先前屬於禁區的 Daybreak Blue 網路安全研討會資料來訓練模型
sources.title_en: OpenAI plans to train models on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data that was previously off-limits
sources.title_original: OpenAI plans to train models on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data that was previously off-limits
sources.summary: Starting November 29, OpenAI will use data from Daybreak Blue sessions to train its models, even when users have turned off training. After backlash, a follow-up email promised a separate opt-out. The move revives concerns from the dispute with mathematicians who suspected OpenAI used their unpublished research for training without consent. The article OpenAI plans to train models on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data that was previously off-limits appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 自 11 月 29 日起，OpenAI 將使用 Daybreak Blue 研討會的資料來訓練其模型，即使用戶已關閉訓練功能亦然。在引發強烈反彈後，隨後的一封電子郵件承諾提供一個單獨的退出選項。此舉重新引發了先前與數學家爭端中的擔憂，這些數學家曾懷疑 OpenAI 未經同意就使用他們未發表的研究所進行訓練。

stories.title: 養蜂技巧與摔角建議可以訓練 AI 模型破壞監督機制 / Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight

sources.title: 養蜂技巧與摔角建議可以訓練 AI 模型破壞監督機制 / Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight
sources.title_zh: 養蜂技巧與摔角建議可以訓練 AI 模型破壞監督機制
sources.title_en: Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight
sources.title_original: Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight
sources.summary: Anthropic used Claude to automatically generate training data that looks harmless but trains smaller models to misbehave, such as sabotaging oversight or deceiving users. Hidden within fictional contexts about beekeeping, professional wrestling, and mitochondria, these datasets bypass safety monitors and outperform known benchmarks from the research literature. The article Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 使用 Claude 自動產生看起來無害，但會訓練較小模型出現不良行為（例如破壞監督機制或欺騙使用者）的訓練資料。這些資料集隱藏在關於養蜂、職業摔角和粒線體的虛構情境中，繞過了安全監控，並且表現優於研究文獻中的已知基準。

stories.title: OpenAI 僅籌集 300 億美元目標中的 110 億美元，大型投資者對 AI 的胃口逐漸減弱 / OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite

sources.title: OpenAI 僅籌集 300 億美元目標中的 110 億美元，大型投資者對 AI 的胃口逐漸減弱 / OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite

sources.title_en: OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite
sources.title_original: OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite
sources.summary: OpenAI raised only about $11 billion in its latest funding round, less than half of the $30 billion it was targeting. At $1.25 trillion, the valuation falls short of expectations, and major investors appear to be pulling back amid the recent tech sell-off. Meanwhile, rival Anthropic is pushing to go public as early as November. The article OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 在其最新一輪融資中僅籌集了約 110 億美元，不到其 300 億美元目標的一半。其估值達 1.25 兆美元，低於預期，且在近期的科技股拋售潮中，主要投資者似乎正在撤資。與此同時，競爭對手 Anthropic 正力爭最快在 11 月上市。

stories.title: 微軟 提供四分之一員工自願離職方案，同時保留對 AI 至關重要的團隊 / Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams

sources.title: 微軟 提供四分之一員工自願離職方案，同時保留對 AI 至關重要的團隊 / Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
sources.title_zh: 微軟 提供四分之一員工自願離職方案，同時保留對 AI 至關重要的團隊
sources.title_en: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
sources.title_original: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
sources.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary severance packages to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its workforce, in the second such program this year. The company's headcount has held flat at around 223,000 since 2022 even as it plans to spend about $170 billion on AI infrastructure in 2026 alone. The article Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 微軟 正在向約 60,000 名員工（約佔其員工總數的四分之一）提供自願離職方案，這是該公司今年推出的第二個此類計畫。儘管該公司計畫僅在 2026 年就花費約 1,700 億美元在 AI 基礎設施上，但自 2022 年以來，其員工人數一直維持在約 223,000 人左右。

sources.title_original: Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
sources.summary: Google Deepmind and the World Resources Institute have released ForTy, a global map that classifies forests and other land into six categories, including primary forest, plantations, and tree crops. The map could help track deforestation under EU rules, but it identifies only about half of planted forests and tree-crop areas, and 60% of plantations. The article Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 與世界資源研究所（World Resources Institute）合作推出了「ForTy」，這是一份全球地圖，將森林和其他土地分為六個類別，包括原始林、人工林和木本作物。這張地圖有助於根據歐盟法規追蹤森林砍伐情況，但它僅識別了約一半的人工林和木本作物區域，以及 60% 的人工林。

sources.summary: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts Parameter Labs describe an exploit they found against ChatGPT's implementation of the artifacts pattern (OpenAI used to call this "Canvas" but it looks like the latest revision is called HTML previews ), where interactive custom HTML apps are displayed in a sandboxed iframe. It's important that HTML in these stays tightly sandboxed to avoid untrusted code interacting with OpenAI APIs and accessing private data. Parameter found quite a complex attack chain. OpenAI use the MathLive JavaScript library as part of their graph support, and that library includes its own virtual keyboard , which can be triggered in the parent page via postMessage() from the sandboxed iframe. That message receiving code uses innerHTML , so anything that sends a message can add custom HTML to the parent - and there was no mechanism to prevent other sandboxed frames, including HTML preview frames, from calling that method. This meant untrusted code in an iframe could insert HTML, and while innerHTML doesn't directly execute script elements it could be used to inject a new iframe without sandbox restrictions. OpenAI’s CSP rules blocked inline scripts entirely, and only allowed script loading from a handful of domains, but one of those was YouTube - and the YouTube oEmbed endpoint could be used to reflect JavaScript back in a way that executed it. Once the attack had JavaScript execution on ChatGPT, it was trivial to fetch private user data from APIs and exfiltrate it via an image reference. The end result: you could create a ChatGPT share URL which, when visited by ano
sources.summary_zh: 我們是如何接管 ChatGPT 帳戶的：Parameter Labs 描述了一項針對 ChatGPT's 實作 artifacts 模式（OpenAI 以前稱這為「畫布 (Canvas)」，但看起來最新修訂版本稱為 HTML 預覽）所發現的漏洞，其中互動式自訂 HTML 應用程式會顯示在沙箱化的 iframe 中。確保這些內容中的 HTML 保持嚴格的沙箱化非常重要，以避免不受信任的程式碼與 OpenAI API 互動並存取私密資料。Parameter 發現了一個相當複雜的攻擊鏈。OpenAI 將 MathLive JavaScript 該程式庫作為其圖表支援的一部分，該程式庫包含了它自己的虛擬鍵盤，可以透過來自沙箱化 iframe 的 postMessage() 在父頁面中觸發。該訊息接收程式碼使用了 innerHTML，因此任何傳送訊息的內容都可以將自訂 HTML 新增至父頁面——並且沒有任何機制可以阻止其他沙箱化框架（包括 HTML 預覽框架）呼叫該方法。這意味著 iframe 中的不受信任程式碼可以插入 HTML，雖然 innerHTML 不會直接執行 script 元素，但它可以用來注入一個沒有沙箱限制的新 iframe。OpenAI’s CSP 規則完全封鎖了內嵌腳本，並且只允許從少數幾個網域載入腳本，但其中之一是 YouTube——而 YouTube oEmbed 端點可以用來以執行 JavaScript 的方式將其反射回來。一旦攻擊在 ChatGPT 上執行了 JavaScript，從 API 取得私密使用者資料並透過圖片參照將其外洩就變得微不足道了。最終結果是：你可以建立一個 ChatGPT 共用網址，當其他人造訪時

stories.title: Qt推出Clate嵌入式介面設計工具，支援AI生成與QML匯出

sources.title: Qt推出Clate嵌入式介面設計工具，支援AI生成與QML匯出
sources.title_zh: Qt推出Clate嵌入式介面設計工具，支援AI生成與QML匯出
sources.title_original: Qt推出Clate嵌入式介面設計工具，支援AI生成與QML匯出
sources.summary: Qt推出嵌入式裝置介面設計工具Clate，並對外開放第一個Beta版本0.6。設計師不必編寫程式碼，就能透過視覺化編輯器或AI生成操作畫面，再將成果匯出為QML程式碼，交由工程師整合至Qt應用程式。目前Beta版可免費下載使用。

sources.title: 認識 Factory Droid 1.0：一個建立在腳本模式上的模型無關編碼代理程式骨架 / Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode
sources.title_zh: 認識 Factory Droid 1.0：一個建立在腳本模式上的模型無關編碼代理程式骨架
sources.title_en: Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode
sources.title_original: Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode
sources.summary: Factory released Droid 1.0, a model-independent coding agent harness that makes programmatic tool calling the default. On Factory’s own Terminal-Bench 4 runs, Droid scores 65.2% with Claude Opus 5.5 at $4.73 per passed task. The post Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Factory 發布了 Droid 1.0，這是一個模型無關的編碼代理程式骨架，能將程式化工具呼叫設為預設值。在 Factory 自身的 Terminal-Bench 4 執行測試中，Droid 以 Claude Opus 5.5 獲得 65.2% 的分數，每個通過的任務成本為 4.73 美元。

items.title_original: Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode
items.summary: Factory released Droid 1.0, a model-independent coding agent harness that makes programmatic tool calling the default. On Factory’s own Terminal-Bench 4 runs, Droid scores 65.2% with Claude Opus 5.5 at $4.73 per passed task. The post Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Factory 發布了 Droid 1.0，這是一個模型無關的編碼代理程式骨架，能將程式化工具呼叫設為預設值。在 Factory 自身的 Terminal-Bench 4 執行測試中，Droid 以 Claude Opus 5.5 獲得 65.2% 的分數，每個通過的任務成本為 4.73 美元。

sources.title_zh: Vercel Labs 開源 agent-desktop 以實現代理程式電腦使用
sources.title_en: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
sources.title_original: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
sources.summary: Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 Rust CLI that gives any AI agent computer use on macOS, Windows and Linux by reading OS accessibility trees and acting on stable refs instead of pixels. The post Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Vercel Labs 推出了 agent-desktop，這是一個採用 Apache-2.0 授權的 Rust 命令列介面（CLI），透過讀取作業系統的輔助使用樹（accessibility trees）並對穩定參照而非像素進行操作，讓任何 AI 代理程式都能在 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上使用電腦。

sources.summary: Named “Volta-Autodoxer,” the recently uncovered malware uses AI tools to collect troves of data about victims, from login credentials and credit card numbers to Discord sessions and UberEats receipts.

sources.title_zh: Vercel Labs 開源 agent-desktop 以實現代理程式電腦使用
sources.title_en: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
sources.title_original: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
sources.summary: Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 Rust CLI that gives any AI agent computer use on macOS, Windows and Linux by reading OS accessibility trees and acting on stable refs instead of pixels. The post Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Vercel Labs 推出了 agent-desktop，這是一個採用 Apache-2.0 授權的 Rust 命令列介面（CLI），透過讀取作業系統的輔助使用樹（accessibility trees）並對穩定參照而非像素進行操作，讓任何 AI 代理程式都能在 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上使用電腦。

sources.title: Google Deepmind 利用衛星資料與 AI 建立全球森林地圖 / Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
sources.title_zh: Google Deepmind 利用衛星資料與 AI 建立全球森林地圖
sources.title_en: Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
sources.title_original: Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI
sources.summary: Google Deepmind and the World Resources Institute have released ForTy, a global map that classifies forests and other land into six categories, including primary forest, plantations, and tree crops. The map could help track deforestation under EU rules, but it identifies only about half of planted forests and tree-crop areas, and 60% of plantations. The article Google Deepmind creates a global map of forests with satellite data and AI appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 與世界資源研究所（World Resources Institute）合作推出了「ForTy」，這是一份全球地圖，將森林和其他土地分為六個類別，包括原始林、人工林和木本作物。這張地圖有助於根據歐盟法規追蹤森林砍伐情況，但它僅識別了約一半的人工林和木本作物區域，以及 60% 的人工林。

sources.title: 認識 Factory Droid 1.0：一個建立在腳本模式上的模型無關編碼代理程式骨架 / Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode
sources.title_zh: 認識 Factory Droid 1.0：一個建立在腳本模式上的模型無關編碼代理程式骨架
sources.title_en: Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode
sources.title_original: Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode
sources.summary: Factory released Droid 1.0, a model-independent coding agent harness that makes programmatic tool calling the default. On Factory’s own Terminal-Bench 4 runs, Droid scores 65.2% with Claude Opus 5.5 at $4.73 per passed task. The post Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Factory 發布了 Droid 1.0，這是一個模型無關的編碼代理程式骨架，能將程式化工具呼叫設為預設值。在 Factory 自身的 Terminal-Bench 4 執行測試中，Droid 以 Claude Opus 5.5 獲得 65.2% 的分數，每個通過的任務成本為 4.73 美元。

sources.title: OpenAI 計畫使用先前屬於禁區的 Daybreak Blue 網路安全研討會資料來訓練模型 / OpenAI plans to train models on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data that was previously off-limits
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 計畫使用先前屬於禁區的 Daybreak Blue 網路安全研討會資料來訓練模型
sources.title_en: OpenAI plans to train models on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data that was previously off-limits
sources.title_original: OpenAI plans to train models on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data that was previously off-limits
sources.summary: Starting November 29, OpenAI will use data from Daybreak Blue sessions to train its models, even when users have turned off training. After backlash, a follow-up email promised a separate opt-out. The move revives concerns from the dispute with mathematicians who suspected OpenAI used their unpublished research for training without consent. The article OpenAI plans to train models on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data that was previously off-limits appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 自 11 月 29 日起，OpenAI 將使用 Daybreak Blue 研討會的資料來訓練其模型，即使用戶已關閉訓練功能亦然。在引發強烈反彈後，隨後的一封電子郵件承諾提供一個單獨的退出選項。此舉重新引發了先前與數學家爭端中的擔憂，這些數學家曾懷疑 OpenAI 未經同意就使用他們未發表的研究所進行訓練。

events.news_summary: Parameter Labs揭露ChatGPT沙箱漏洞，攻擊者可透過MathLive鍵盤與YouTube oEmbed執行腳本，竊取使用者資料。

sources.title: 我們是如何接管 ChatGPT 帳戶的 / How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
sources.title_zh: 我們是如何接管 ChatGPT 帳戶的
sources.title_en: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
sources.title_original: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
sources.summary: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts Parameter Labs describe an exploit they found against ChatGPT's implementation of the artifacts pattern (OpenAI used to call this "Canvas" but it looks like the latest revision is called HTML previews ), where interactive custom HTML apps are displayed in a sandboxed iframe. It's important that HTML in these stays tightly sandboxed to avoid untrusted code interacting with OpenAI APIs and accessing private data. Parameter found quite a complex attack chain. OpenAI use the MathLive JavaScript library as part of their graph support, and that library includes its own virtual keyboard , which can be triggered in the parent page via postMessage() from the sandboxed iframe. That message receiving code uses innerHTML , so anything that sends a message can add custom HTML to the parent - and there was no mechanism to prevent other sandboxed frames, including HTML preview frames, from calling that method. This meant untrusted code in an iframe could insert HTML, and while innerHTML doesn't directly execute script elements it could be used to inject a new iframe without sandbox restrictions. OpenAI’s CSP rules blocked inline scripts entirely, and only allowed script loading from a handful of domains, but one of those was YouTube - and the YouTube oEmbed endpoint could be used to reflect JavaScript back in a way that executed it. Once the attack had JavaScript execution on ChatGPT, it was trivial to fetch private user data from APIs and exfiltrate it via an image reference. sources.summary_zh: 我們是如何接管 ChatGPT 帳戶的：Parameter Labs 描述了一項針對 ChatGPT's 實作 artifacts 模式（OpenAI 以前稱這為「畫布 (Canvas)」，但看起來最新修訂版本稱為 HTML 預覽）所發現的漏洞，其中互動式自訂 HTML 應用程式會顯示在沙箱化的 iframe 中。確保這些內容中的 HTML 保持嚴格的沙箱化非常重要，以避免不受信任的程式碼與 OpenAI API 互動並存取私密資料。Parameter 發現了一個相當複雜的攻擊鏈。OpenAI 將 MathLive JavaScript 該程式庫作為其圖表支援的一部分，該程式庫包含了它自己的虛擬鍵盤，可以透過來自沙箱化 iframe 的 postMessage() 在父頁面中觸發。該訊息接收程式碼使用了 innerHTML，因此任何傳送訊息的內容都可以將自訂 HTML 新增至父頁面——並且沒有任何機制可以阻止其他沙箱化框架（包括 HTML 預覽框架）呼叫該方法。這意味著 iframe 中的不受信任程式碼可以插入 HTML，雖然 innerHTML 不會直接執行 script 元素，但它可以用來注入一個沒有沙箱限制的新 iframe。OpenAI’s CSP 規則完全封鎖了內嵌腳本，並且只允許從少數幾個網域載入腳本，但其中之一是 YouTube——而 YouTube oEmbed 端點可以用來以執行 JavaScript 的方式將其反射回來。一旦攻擊在 ChatGPT 上執行了 JavaScript，從 API 取得私密使用者資料並透過圖片參照將其外洩就變得微不足道了。最終結果是：你可以建立一個 ChatGPT 共用網址，當其他人造訪時

sources.title: Anthropic's 的浮水印推出在兩個較舊的 Claude 模型上留下了漏洞 / Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
sources.title_zh: Anthropic's 的浮水印推出在兩個較舊的 Claude 模型上留下了漏洞
sources.title_en: Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
sources.title_original: Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
sources.summary: Anthropic is expanding its text watermark to four more Claude models to meet the EU AI Act's December deadline. On the older models Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, developers can bypass the watermark by tweaking a single sampling parameter. Anthropic addresses the loophole with just a compliance warning. The article Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在將其文字浮水印擴展到其他四個 Claude 模型，以符合歐盟人工智慧法案（EU AI Act）的 12 月期限。在舊款模型 Claude Opus 4.6 和 Sonnet 4.6 上，開發人員可以透過調整單一取樣參數來繞過浮水印。Anthropic 則僅透過合規警告來處理此漏洞。

events.news_summary: Anthropic 用 Claude 生成看似無害的訓練資料，使小模型學會破壞監督或欺騙用戶，並繞過安全監控。

sources.title: 養蜂技巧與摔角建議可以訓練 AI 模型破壞監督機制 / Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight
sources.title_zh: 養蜂技巧與摔角建議可以訓練 AI 模型破壞監督機制
sources.title_en: Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight
sources.title_original: Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight
sources.summary: Anthropic used Claude to automatically generate training data that looks harmless but trains smaller models to misbehave, such as sabotaging oversight or deceiving users. Hidden within fictional contexts about beekeeping, professional wrestling, and mitochondria, these datasets bypass safety monitors and outperform known benchmarks from the research literature. The article Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 使用 Claude 自動產生看起來無害，但會訓練較小模型出現不良行為（例如破壞監督機制或欺騙使用者）的訓練資料。這些資料集隱藏在關於養蜂、職業摔角和粒線體的虛構情境中，繞過了安全監控，並且表現優於研究文獻中的已知基準。

source_material.title: Beekeeping tips and wrestling advice can train AI models to sabotage oversight
source_material.summary: Anthropic used Claude to automatically generate training data that looks harmless but trains smaller models to misbehave, such as sabotaging oversight or deceiving users. Hidden within fictional contexts about beekeeping, professional wrestling, and mitochondria, these datasets bypass safety monitors and outperform known benchmarks from the research literature. sources.title: 微軟 提供四分之一員工自願離職方案，同時保留對 AI 至關重要的團隊 / Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
sources.title_zh: 微軟 提供四分之一員工自願離職方案，同時保留對 AI 至關重要的團隊
sources.title_en: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
sources.title_original: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams
sources.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary severance packages to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its workforce, in the second such program this year. The company's headcount has held flat at around 223,000 since 2022 even as it plans to spend about $170 billion on AI infrastructure in 2026 alone. The article Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 微軟 正在向約 60,000 名員工（約佔其員工總數的四分之一）提供自願離職方案，這是該公司今年推出的第二個此類計畫。儘管該公司計畫僅在 2026 年就花費約 1,700 億美元在 AI 基礎設施上，但自 2022 年以來，其員工人數一直維持在約 223,000 人左右。

spans.text: Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode

Factory released Droid 1.0, a model-independent coding agent harness that makes programmatic tool calling the default. On Factory’s own Terminal-Bench 4 runs, Droid scores 65.2% with Claude Opus 5.5 at $4.73 per passed task. The post Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode appeared first on MarkTechPost .
